title: Interface list page: four userActions toggles still read `=== true` while the shared UserActionsConfigSchema publishes them on by default (hideFields, filter, rowHeight, group)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Ruled: 6574404727 · letter A · 2026-11-02T10:07Z

Filing gate: ① a should-fix from the contract review of PR #29083 (#28912), record 6572308637. It is outside that card's surface (the list view). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Reach: authors of interface pages (`interfaceConfig.userActions`, the same `UserActionsConfigSchema` as a list view, `page.zod.ts` ≈L1076). The published contract says these toggles are on by default. The page draws them only for an explicit `true`.

## Where (on `main`, after PR #29083)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx` ≈L589 reads `userActions.hideFields === true` off `cfg.userActions || {}`, and does the same for `filter`, `rowHeight` and `group`. The spec defaults for all four are `true`.
- The result splits on whether the document was parsed. For a parsed block that omits the key, the materialised `true` satisfies `=== true` and the control is drawn. For an absent block, or an unparsed stored page, it stays closed.

## Wanted (pick one, triage or the ui seat)

- A: `InterfaceListPage` reads the spec defaults for the four toggles (`!== false`), so one contract holds on both surfaces. Or:
- B: the spec gives the interface page its own documented defaults (closed), with a schema of its own or a documented override, and says so in the describe.

Also, on next touch: the semantic entry `18.list-view-hide-fields-default-on`'s sentence "An interface page keeps its own closed-by-default toolbar and still draws the control only for an explicit `true`" overstates the page's closedness for a parsed block. Qualify it in line with A or B.

Dedupe: searched `InterfaceListPage userActions === true`; only #28912 / PR #29083. **New.**
